paths.description: Include globs (ripgrep dialect: `**`, `{a,b}`). Omit for everything under cwd.

search.description: Regex (Rust dialect). When set, results are filtered to files containing at least one match.

hidden.description: Include hidden files and directories. Default `false`.

depth.description: Max walk depth. Omit for unbounded. Depth counts from each starting point: 0 includes only the starting path itself, 1 includes immediate children, 2 includes grandchildren, etc. Use 1 to list files directly in cwd.

into.description: Frances variable name. When set, the full result lands in the variable AND an inline summary is returned.
